title: The algorithm doc, the products doc and the two posture files fall back to an empty string when missing
evidence: Root fix R24 (US-15 AC72): the algorithm doc, products doc and both postures join CHAT_PROMPT in app/lib/chat-system-prompt.server.ts (loadChatPrompt, CHAT_DOC_FILES). Absent, unreadable or blank makes it 'missing' with the file names, one Sentry error per start, and the AC65 refusal. chat.server.ts reads them only from 'loaded'. Pins: app/lib/chat-system-prompt.server.test.ts, app/routes/api.chat.prompt-missing.test.ts, tests/dockerignore.test.ts (all five in the checkout and the build context).
